function: Downlink cascaded BS-RIS-user channel estimation from received pilots, by a model trained with federated learning (p. 1, 3)
system: 16-antenna UPA base station, 15 single-antenna users, passive reflecting RIS with 64 elements, narrowband FDD, 28 GHz (p. 1-3)
method: Conv/BN/ReLU/FC network trained by supervised federated learning on LS labels with MSE loss; PCA and K-means user clustering, model validation checks (p. 2-3)
data_channel: Own simulator: Saleh-Valenzuela BS-RIS and RIS-user channels with 3 paths each; 2x10^4 samples per user, LS labels, 90% training/validation and 10% testing (p. 3)
test_conditions: Same simulated cell for training and testing (Scenario 2, 3 regions), SNR 5-13 dB; test set covers the whole cell; Scenarios 1-3 redefine regions (p. 3-4)
baselines: Non-learned LS and MMSE; learned all-user federated estimation (AU) of [5], [9], [13]; own strategies MR2 and MR2-40% (p. 3-4)
metrics: NMSE versus SNR; communication overhead in floating points exchanged; pilot overhead; frequency of users flagged by validation check (p. 4)
complexity: About 2x10^6 trainable parameters (10^6 for small model); communication overhead 3.1x10^9 floating points (AU) versus 0.31x10^9 (EUS-m); no FLOPs or runtime (p. 3-4)
q1_support: p. 3: "is generated using the Saleh-Valenzuela channel model"; the BS-RIS channel is also a custom 3-path model, so no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "test dataset representing the entire cell with equal contributions from each cluster"; the proposed model is trained on users of all regions and tested on the same cell, and the paper never states that a model trained in one scenario or configuration is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 3: "namely All-User (AU) and explored in [5], [9], and [13]"; p. 4: "additional benchmarks like the LS and MMSE algorithms"; both are compared on NMSE (Fig. 3).
q4_support: p. 3: "approximately 2 × 10^6 trainable parameters" and "approximately 10^6 trainable parameters" for the small model; no FLOPs or runtime, and Table I (p. 4) is communication overhead only.
q5_support: p. 3: "employs the LS algorithm to generate labels for the cascaded channel"; the data are self-generated, and the letter gives no code or data link, DOI, or public dataset.
notes: Federated learning here is digital (no over-the-air aggregation), so the area follows the function (channel estimation, area 2). q3 relies on AU being the classical FL estimator that the paper attributes to [5], [9], [13]. q4 rests only on the stated parameter count (Table I is communication overhead, not used). MR2 is tested on a region unseen in its training but is a degraded benchmark, so q2 is 0.
